note: The band-2hop family (design: speech_log 2026-10-27 late, 'the band answers'). Four scripts, 2 tells + 2 asks each. Every ask is 2-hop by construction: the cue word lives in M1 only, the answer word in M2 only, joined by a bridge token; no question shares a distinctive word with the answer memory at coverage 0.6 or better, so the direct one-hop path must refuse or pick the wrong memory. All words verified known against word_patterns by tmp_band2hop_vocab.py (10,138 entries; bark/drifts/flares are NOT known and are excluded). Graded mechanically like the main suite: any_of = at least one of these words in the reply.

scripts.name: band-hop-1
scripts.note: M1 bell/noon/rings; M2 noon/owl/spins/salt. Ask1 cue=bell verb=spins -> M2 subject owl. Ask2 cue=owl verb=rings -> M1 subject bell.
